catalog_quote: 2.10 Accent Normally the accent is placed on the first syllable of the root. ... [2.2.3:] In Mankanya, nouns and verbs often have prefixes of the form [P ə] (where ‘P’ is a stop or a nasal). ... [pəˈkʊmɛl] central pillar of a house [məˈjik] it’s hot [bəˈtək] mortar [ŋəˈde] we eat [dəˈjɐ] I'm going It is difficult to find true contrasts between [P ə] and [Pə], because [Pə] is normally found at the beginning of words and unstressed. [Pə] can be found initially in some inflected words, but it is then also stem initial and stressed. [ˈpə.nɐn] take out! [ˈbə.bɐn] wrap! [ˈkə.bɐn] enter! [Pə] can also be found in some non-initial non-stressed contexts: [kaˈnθiː.nta.məʂ] folk story [pəˈnde.mənt] tongue [ɐˈbə.rəʂ] he grinds ... I will therefore interpret [ə] as a preaccentual realisation of /ə/. ... [2.9:] kɐˈtoh house CV.CVC nɐˈme clairvoyant CV.CV ʊˈko animal V.CV ... 2.11 Tone Mankanya is not…

audit.reasoning: The deciding quotation is verbatim in the held LOT fulltext at the stated places (sec. 2.10 p. 29; sec. 2.2.3 pp. 11-12; sec. 2.9 p. 29). The source is the 2020 reference grammar, the newest and fullest description Glottolog lists; the transcribed examples throughout ch. 2 independently show unstressed C(ə)-/V- prefixes and root-initial stress, matching the 'morphological (root-initial)' coding. A newly fetched sources 2026 phonology sheet by Creissels (Atlantic specialist) states the same rule ('accent de mot... première syllabe de la base lexicale') and no tone. No instrumental or dedicated prosody study was found. Trifkovič 1969 (print-only) could add detail on exceptions behind Gaved's 'Normally' but nothing seen suggests a different coding.

sources.citation: Creissels, Denis. 2026. Phonologie du mankanya (ou mancagne). Fiche LGMEF (Langues et Grammaires du Monde dans l'Espace Francophone), DDL/Université Lyon 2, CNRS. HAL hal-05613687. 2 pp.
sources.quote: 'Le mankanya n'a pas de système tonal mais possède un accent de mot qui marque en règle générale la première syllabe de la base lexicale du mot (c'est-à-dire pratiquement la première ou la deuxième syllabe du mot, selon sa structure morphologique).'
